acceptance_criteria.description: Code2truth intake must build a source inventory from existing code, docs, skills, tests, CLI behavior, Beacon lighthouse/source-architecture outputs, and available provider artifacts.
Third-party or local code-map providers such as `qi-dev-understand-anything` must be treated as evidence providers only, never as requirement authority.
Intake must reconstruct candidate truth with source refs, confidence, and ambiguity markers for each material claim.
Candidate truth can become formal truth only after user confirmation and governed promotion into the Beacon feature package.
The frozen truth source must be resolver-selected `features/<slug>/{truth,tests,tasks,evidence}.md`; generated JSON, legacy triptych, provider graphs, and support research cannot win authority.
`beacon implement` may complete as no-op/evidence-only execution when frozen ACs are already satisfied by existing code and every task has evidence-backed closure.
`tasks.md` must express implementation intent and may mark existing-code satisfaction through evidence refs; it must not fake source churn or replace execution/gate evidence.
`beacon QA` must validate truth-map resolution, package coverage, evidence refs, provider boundary, governance/doctor verification, and current behavior satisfaction.
Ambiguous, stale, conflicting, low-confidence, or unproven behavior must fail closed into questions, exclusions, or change routing instead of freezing as authoritative truth.

The intake model must support a bounded pilot on an existing skill project such as `/Users/apple/Developer/Personal/products/justin-mc-lai-skills`, preferably by one skill pack before whole-repo adoption.

test_rows.assertion: Intake builds a source inventory from code, docs, skills, tests, CLI behavior, Beacon source maps, and available provider artifacts.
Provider artifacts from `qi-dev-understand-anything` / Understand-Anything are recorded as evidence refs and cannot be marked as requirement authority.
Candidate truth output includes source refs, confidence, and ambiguity markers for material claims.
Candidate truth is not promoted to package truth until user confirmation and governed truth/change routing occur.
`beacon truth-map resolve` selects `features/<slug>/{truth,tests,tasks,evidence}.md` as authority and generated JSON/provider graphs cannot override it.
Implement admission can close with no source diff when frozen ACs are satisfied by existing behavior and evidence.
`tasks.md` records existing-code satisfaction and evidence refs without pretending task checkboxes are implementation, QA, or release gates.
QA validates package coverage, evidence refs, provider boundary, governance/doctor verification, and current behavior satisfaction.
Ambiguous, stale, conflicting, low-confidence, or unproven behavior is excluded, questioned, or routed to change instead of frozen as truth.
A bounded existing-project pilot, such as one `justin-mc-lai-skills` skill pack, can be analyzed without whole-repo forced adoption.

task_rows.title: Define the source inventory model for code, docs, skills, tests, CLI behavior, Beacon source maps, and provider artifacts.
Define provider authority boundaries for `qi-dev-understand-anything` / Understand-Anything and similar code-map tools.
Define candidate truth reconstruction with source refs, confidence, and ambiguity markers.
Require user confirmation before candidate truth can be promoted into package-authoritative truth.
Freeze package authority through `truth-map` selected `truth.md`, `tests.md`, `tasks.md`, and `evidence.md`.
Define implement no-op/evidence-only admission when existing code satisfies frozen truth.
Define QA coverage for package truth, provider evidence, governance verify, and current behavior satisfaction.
Preserve fail-closed routing for ambiguous, stale, conflicting, low-confidence, or unproven behavior.
Support a bounded pilot on an existing project or skill pack before whole-repo adoption.
